body.condition: For every \(s\in\mathcal S\), \(x\in\mathcal X\), \(u\in\mathcal U\), and \(w\in J_x\), the anchor-zero subspace \(D_{a_s}\) is contained in the range of \(\mathscr L_{s,x,u,w}\).

novel.justification: The condition is imposed only on proxy categories actually used by the causal lift and continues to allow structural zeros in the joint potential-outcome support.
